narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The creator is sharing a personal 'disaster' story about spilling a smoothie on his expensive laptop. By highlighting the shock of the high repair cost and his emotional state, he aims to engage his audience for sympathy and practical advice on whether to repair or replace the device.
